description: This file implements a public domain SHA-256 cryptographic hash function and a main program that processes an input file to generate a specific TLV-encoded output with a SHA-256 checksum.

classes.name: sha256
classes.description: Structure representing the SHA-256 context with message length, hash state, and buffer.

methods.name: ror
methods.description: Performs a rotate right operation on a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: processblock
methods.description: Processes a 64-byte block of data for SHA-256 computation.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads the message to align with SHA-256 block size and finalizes the message length.

methods.name: sha256_sum
methods.description: Computes the final SHA-256 hash value.

methods.name: sha256_update
methods.description: Updates the SHA-256 context with new data.

methods.name: write_tlv
methods.description: Writes a TLV (Type-Length-Value) structure to a file.

methods.name: write_tlv_string
methods.description: Writes a TLV structure with a string value to a file.
